idee_recherchee.texte: Doctors say some medical conditions cause pain so extreme that patients describe it as worse than death, and even strong painkillers barely help.

titre_video: Insane Pain Facts, From Phantom Limbs to Brain Freeze
titre: Pain is like a good cop
resume: Fact 42: a pain-free life would cause trouble because pain means nerves are telling the brain something is wrong so you can fix it, and like a good cop it tries to keep you alive.
texte: something you ought to know. Number 42. Some of you would likely vote for having a pain-free life. But if you felt no pain, you'd be in trouble. You feel pain because the nerves in your body are telling your brain there is something [music] wrong. You can then fix whatever is wrong. So pain, just like a good cop, is trying its best to keep you alive.
